review.why: Builds reusable n8n sub-workflows: search before building, typed inputs, stateless versus stateful design, tagging, middleware and fire-and-forget patterns.
review.summary: Treats sub-workflows as functions with a typed trigger and a clean return. It sets rules to search first and define inputs below, a decision tree for when to extract, the difference between stateless and deliberately stateful sub-workflows, and patterns for async audit logging and middleware such as token checks. Naming and pattern details are in two references.
strengths: Warns against accidental state, such as a pure-looking workflow that writes a log
Node groups are suggested when the only goal is a tidier canvas
cautions: Later sections and two reference files are not read here
Requires n8n tag search features of recent versions
